notes.title: Moen Patch #2
notes.content:
[h1]🛠️  Major Updates: 🛠️[/h1]
[list]
[*] Memory Leak Fixed: Say goodbye to performance drops! We've resolved a significant memory leak that caused issues over time.
[*] Performance Boost: Experience smoother gameplay with massive performance improvements across the board.
[*] New Main Menu: Fresh new look for the main menu, improving navigation and user experience.
[*] New Save System: Introducing Whale Totems! Your progress is now saved via this new system. Collections now save properly, ensuring your progress is always up-to-date.
[*] Quest System: The first version of the quest system is here, with plans to expand it in future updates.
[*] Halloween Backpack: Get a free spooky backpack to celebrate the season!
[/list]

[h1]🟢 Online Features: 🟢[/h1]
[list]
[*] Friends List: The friends list is now fully functional—connect with your friends and see who's online!
[*] Speed run Leaderboards: Track your best times with the fully operational speed run leaderboards.
[*] Online Climbers List: See where you stand among other climbers online.
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay Improvements:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Book UI Updated: The in-game book UI has been revamped for better clarity and ease of use.
[*] Improved Chat Filter: The chat filter has been updated to better handle inappropriate content.
[*] Improved Camera System: The camera system has been refined for smoother and more intuitive control.
[*] 
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*] Inspecting Player with Controller: This feature currently doesn't work but will be fixed in a future update.
[*] Texture Issues: Some textures may appear incorrectly or inconsistently.
[*] Mushroom Spawns: Mushrooms can sometimes spawn in undesirable or hard-to-reach locations.
[*] Low Graphics Assets: Some assets may not appear correctly on lower settings.
[*] Emote Wheel on Controller: The emote wheel may not function properly when using a controller.
[/list]

notes.title: Moen Patch #1
notes.content:
Thank you, everyone, for playing the launch of Moen! We are actively working to fix bugs and enhance the overall experience. This patch focuses on the following improvements:

[h1]Fixed[/h1]

[list]
[*] Enhanced grass performance
[*] Added a save position feature
[*] Resolved various UI issues
[*] Fixed the bug allowing players to be in two parties simultaneously
[*] Corrected the issue of private servers closing randomly after speed run completion
[/list]


We are currently addressing the following issues:

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]

[list]
[*] Controllers not being recognized
[*] General user-friendliness of controllers
[*] Performance and frame rate issues
[*] Collectibles and certain stats not functioning properly
[*] UI disappearing in certain instances
[*] We will continue to monitor and improve the game!
[/list]

Happy Climbing!
